summary: Quiet street kerb beside a vacant grassed lot and bush, no cars parked.
reasons: Backs onto vacant lot and bush

best_section.where: north kerb along the vacant grassed lot, east end of the bend

drivers.seclusion: North side is a vacant grass lot; bush opposite. Nearest dwellings 90 m along and 40 m+ across the lot. Construction site and flats to the east.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a kerb and a grass verge; no vehicles parked along it, so room beside the lane is unproven.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential loop serving new houses and a construction site; some construction traffic likely.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this section and no marked parking, so no convention for overnight stays.

flags: Homes at 6 m from 90 m onwards, so avoid the western end
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees at the east end shade it in the morning.
